title: Short-Form Video Editor (CapCut) – Faceless Music Reels & TikToks
description:
We're Blackwake Audio, a music label creating short-form content for our artists. We need a reliable part-time editor to turn our songs into faceless vertical clips for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. This is templated, repeatable work. Once you learn our style, it's fast.

What you'll do:



Edit short vertical videos (9:16, 1080×1920), 8–15 seconds each, from a brief we give you.

Each clip is a simple "vibe loop" background + on-screen caption text + a cut of our song, synced so the hook lands in the first second.

Source background loops from free stock sites (Pexels, Pixabay, Mixkit) or generate them with an AI video tool (Kling, Runway, or Luma — a plus, not required).

Place caption text exactly to our spec for font, size, and position. We provide a one-page style guide and reference clips.

Trim each clip into a seamless loop and export a ready-to-post file.

Deliver in batches, around 20–30 finished clips per week (we'll dial in the exact number during the trial).



What we provide:



The audio cuts, the exact caption text for every clip, and a style guide with examples. You're assembling and sourcing backgrounds, not writing copy or guessing the vibe.



You're a fit if you:



Are fluent in CapCut and fast at templated editing.

Have a sharp eye for clean, readable text and good timing.

Follow a spec precisely. Consistency and text placement matter a lot to us.

Are reliable, communicate clearly in English, and hit deadlines.

Have a portfolio of short-form, vertical, or faceless edits (lyric videos, POV edits, and similar).



Nice to have:



Experience with AI video generators (Kling, Runway, Luma, Sora).

A feel for music and short-form pacing.



Logistics:



Part-time, about 20 hours/week, long-term and ongoing for the right person.

Starts with a paid trial of 3–5 clips so we can both see if it's a fit.

You deliver finished files and will not need access to our social accounts.



To apply:



Start your message with the word "ECHO" so I know you read this.

Send 2–3 examples of faceless or vertical short-form videos you've edited.

Tell me which tools you use and how many simple clips you can turn around per hour.

title: Creator Outreach and Social Media Lead Generation
description:
Can you get a complete stranger to respond to a cold DM?



This isn't a role for someone who sends copy-paste messages and calls it outreach. We need someone who reads the room, adapts their approach, and actually knows what it takes to get a response.



*What this job is*

We're a fast-growing eCommerce company that partners with online content creators. We have a CRM full of creators ready to be contacted — your job is to reach them across X, Instagram, Reddit, and other platforms, start real conversations, and turn those conversations into partnerships. You'll write personalized outreach, manage follow-ups, keep the CRM updated, and test new angles when current ones stop working. Simple concept, genuinely hard to do well.



*Who we're looking for*

- Moves without being pushed — figures things out independently, doesn't wait for direction

- Writes like a human — warm, natural, persuasive English. We test this. ChatGPT applications go straight in the bin.

- Social media fluent — understands why some DMs get replies and most don't, and how tone shifts across platforms

- Persistent — treats low reply rates as a puzzle to solve, not a reason to slow down

- Tech-comfortable — picks up new tools quickly without needing hand-holding



*One thing we need to be upfront about*

This is a full-time, dedicated role — 100% of your focus, not a share of it. We'll ask directly about other clients during interviews and expect honesty. Strong performers earn bonuses and have real room to grow. We take good care of people who do good work and want to be here long-term.



*Here's how to apply*

Read the "Who we're looking for" section above. Do those points describe you? Tell us why — in your own words, not a template, not ChatGPT. We read every application personally and can immediately tell the difference. Be specific, be honest, write like yourself.

Track what type of content performs best

Communicate daily with our videographers and internal team

Help keep our social media accounts active every day

Fast

Reliable

Organized

Responsive during working hours

Comfortable with daily output

Able to work without constant reminders

Interested in learning about electric bikes, scooters, and product content

Looking for long-term steady work

Monday to Friday

8:00 AM to 5:00 PM PST

You cannot communicate clearly

You are not comfortable posting content

Descript

Other AI/video editing tools

I READ THIS

title: Photo Editior
description:
JOB TITLE: E-Commerce Product Photo Editor — Color Correction & Retouching

Type: One-Time Project · Fixed-Price · Remote



ABOUT THE PROJECT

We have a batch of product photos (under 1,000 images) that need professional editing before they go live on our e-commerce store. We need every image to look polished, on-brand, and visually consistent — meaning uniform color grading, matched tones, corrected exposure, and a clean finish across the entire set. No image should look out of place when placed next to another.

The exact image count will be confirmed at project start. All work is fixed-price at $250 total for the full batch, paid upon delivery and approval.



TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS



Canvas Size: 2048 × 2048 px

Max File Size: Under 500 KB per file

Color Mode: sRGB

Resolution: 72 DPI (web-optimized)





DELIVERABLES PER IMAGE (2 versions)

Version 1 — PNG with Transparent Background

Clean cutout, product only, no background. Edges must be precise — no fringing, halos, or rough selections.

Version 2 — JPEG with White Background

Pure white (#FFFFFF) background, optimized compression to stay under 500 KB without sacrificing visible quality.



WHAT WE NEED DONE



Scale and position every product consistently within the 2048×2048 frame

Color correct and color match all images so tone, white balance, and saturation are uniform across the full batch

Retouch any imperfections — dust, reflections, uneven lighting, or blemishes on the product

Background removal (PNG) with clean, professional edges — not auto-select quality

Flatten to white (JPEG) with proper file compression to stay under 500 KB

Deliver a cohesive, catalog-ready set where every image looks like it belongs together





YOU'RE THE RIGHT FIT IF...



You have proven experience editing product photos for e-commerce (Shopify, Amazon, Etsy, etc.)

You work in Photoshop, Lightroom, or equivalent professional tools

You have a sharp eye for color consistency and can match tones across an entire batch

Your background removal work is clean at a professional standard — pen tool or equivalent, not magic wand

You're comfortable with a fixed-price arrangement and can give a realistic turnaround estimate before starting

You communicate proactively and deliver organized, properly named files on time





BUDGET

$250 USD fixed for the full batch (under 1,000 images). This works out to roughly $0.25–$0.50 per image depending on final count — a fair rate for experienced editors based in the Philippines. Payment upon delivery and client approval.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include:



3–5 portfolio samples of past product photo editing (before/after preferred)

Your estimated turnaround time for a batch of this size

A brief note on your workflow and tools



Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

description:
We are a fast-growing e-commerce health & wellness brand. We sell a red-light therapy device that helps women over 50 relieve hip pain caused by menopause. We sell through native-style video ads (VSLs) on Meta and are scaling fast.



We are looking for a skilled DIRECT-RESPONSE VIDEO EDITOR to turn our scripts into high-converting VSLs. You will NOT write copy — we deliver the full script, the hooks, and part of the video material. Your job is to make it convert.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Edit 2–4 VSLs per week (we start with 2, then scale based on results)

- Turn our scripts, hooks and beat-mapping into finished, polished video ads

- Generate and sync voiceover using ElevenLabs (script delivered in English, beat-mapped exactly)

- Add captions, B-roll, pacing, sound design and visual hooks that hold attention

- Source extra B-roll or simple motion graphics when needed

- Iterate fast on winning angles when we ask for variations

(We expect roughly 8–10 hours per VSL.)



MUST-HAVE SKILLS

- Proven DIRECT-RESPONSE editing experience — you have edited VSLs or native ads for a real e-commerce brand before (not just YouTube/social content)

- Strong editing skills in CapCut

- ElevenLabs voiceover generation and clean audio sync

- Animated / word-by-word captions (CapCut auto-captions or Submagic)

- Fluent English (required — all communication and beat-mapping is in English)

- Strong sense of pacing, retention and hook structure for direct-response ads



NICE-TO-HAVE (BIG PLUS)

- Understanding German is a MASSIVE advantage (our audience is German-speaking)

- Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects for cleaner cuts and simple motion graphics

- B-roll sourcing (Storyblocks, Artgrid, etc.)

- Experience editing for a health, wellness, supplement or 50+ audience



TOOLS WE USE

CapCut, ElevenLabs, Submagic, Google Drive / 
, Meta Ads, Slack



HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS

- VSLs delivered on deadline

- Editing quality and retention (hooks, pacing, captions)

- Speed of iteration on winning angles

- Ad performance — strong performers earn a bonus



WORK STYLE

High-performance, fast-moving e-commerce environment. We value ownership, speed and people who think about WHY an ad converts. Workload is project-based and flexible, but deadlines are firm. Start date: June 7th (ASAP).



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY — this is our first filter)

Applications missing any of these will be ignored:



1) Your portfolio / reel including:

   - Which brands you have worked with, and FOR HOW LONG

   - What position / role you held at each

   - A short clip of a VSL or native ad you edited (a cut-down sample is fine)



2) Answer in writing:

   "What is the single most valuable lesson you have learned that you see again and again at every SUCCESSFUL e-commerce brand?"



3) A 60-second Loom video where you:

   - Briefly introduce yourself

   - Explain WHY a VSL for a woman over 50 must be edited differently than a VSL for a Gen-Z supplement audience



Apply by sending your portfolio, your written answer, and your Loom link.

This is a hands-on design and execution role. You will build social content in Figma and make sure it goes live, looks right, and gets handled across the weekend, when our clients are most active. If you are precise, fast, reliable, and you show up when it counts, this is a strong fit with real room to grow and a raise at 30 days based on performance.



SCHEDULE

Thursday through Monday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM PST (US Pacific time). Weekend coverage (Saturday and Sunday) is required and is the core of this role. Your days off are Tuesday and Wednesday.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build social media content (feed posts and Stories) in Figma to each brand's specifications

- Post and schedule content, including Saturday and Sunday

- Handle basic engagement (comments and replies) during weekend hours

- Make quick fixes when something needs correcting, without waiting until Monday

- Communicate clearly: confirm tasks, flag blockers, and give status without being asked



HOW WE WORK IN FIGMA

Figma is the center of everything we do.

- One Figma file per client per month, feed posts and Stories on separate pages

- Every frame named to a convention. Layers named and grouped. No messy files

- You work from a brief and references in FigJam, and pull brand assets from the client's Google Drive folder

- You use components for anything that repeats

- Feed posts at 4:5 (1080x1350). Stories at 9:16 (1080x1920). Export at 2x

- Nothing gets delivered from a work-in-progress frame

- Sample Figma board: 



THE PACE

We move fast. We are highly organized. Working with a creative team of 15+ persons. You will produce and revise content across multiple brands at once, turn feedback around same-day, and keep several clients on schedule. Briefs can land in the morning and need clean execution by end of day. This is a real agency pace. The people who thrive here are quick, organized, and do not need to be chased for status.



THE STANDARD THAT MATTERS MOST

When a request comes in on a weekend, it gets handled the same day. Not Monday. That reliability is the heart of this role.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Required:

- Strong Figma skills. You can work independently from day one, including components, auto-layout, and clean file structure

- Understanding of social media formats (feed posts, Stories, aspect ratios)

- Ability to work from a brief and execute to spec without heavy hand-holding

title: Senior Paid Media Specialist : Google ads / Meta ads / Linkedin Ads
description:
Senior Paid Media Manager — Google, Meta & LinkedIn Ads

Type: Full-time · Location: Remote · Markets served: South Africa, UK, Netherlands, Australia/New Zealand



About the role:



We're building a full-service performance marketing team serving clients across South Africa, the UK, the Netherlands, and ANZ. 

The role will be conducted during Australian business hours.



We're looking for a Senior Paid Media Manager to own paid acquisition end to end — strategy, build, optimisation, and reporting — across Google, Meta, and LinkedIn.



This is a hands-on senior role, not a coordinator seat. You'll be the person in the ad accounts every day, making the calls that move ROAS, CPA, and lead quality. 

You'll work alongside our SEO, web/funnel, creative, and development specialists to ship full-funnel campaigns that actually convert.



What you'll do



-  Plan, build, and manage paid campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube), Meta 
/Instagram, Advantage+), and LinkedIn (Lead Gen Forms, ABM, sponsored content)



- Design and run remarketing and retargeting funnels across all platforms (prospecting ? re-engagement ? conversion)



- Manage budgets across multiple clients, markets, and currencies — allocating spend for efficiency and scale



- Own the metrics: ROAS, CPA, CPL, MER, lead quality, and pipeline impact — and improve them



- Build and structure conversion tracking with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and server-side tracking; partner with our developer where deeper implementation is needed



- Run structured creative testing in partnership with the creative team (audiences, hooks, formats, offers)



-Produce clear, client-ready reporting (Looker Studio or similar) that ties spend to outcomes, not vanity metrics

Collaborate with SEO, funnel, and dev to keep landing pages and tracking aligned with campaign goals



Stay current on platform changes and bring proactive recommendations, not just execution



What we're looking for



4+ years of hands-on paid media experience managing live budgets (agency or in-house)



Proven, demonstrable results across both Google and Meta — dual-platform expertise is essential, not a bonus



Working experience with LinkedIn Ads, especially lead gen and B2B targeting



Strong command of GA4, GTM, conversion tracking, and attribution



Comfortable managing multiple accounts and markets simultaneously, with the organisation to keep them all on track



Data-driven and commercially minded — you optimise toward revenue and lead quality, not just clicks



Excellent written English and clear, proactive communication (you'll be client-facing and async-heavy)



Able to work hours that overlap with our client markets (see Hours below)



Nice to have



TikTok, YouTube, or programmatic experience

Experience with e-commerce (Advantage+ Shopping, catalog/DPA) and lead-gen funnels

Familiarity with CRO and landing-page optimisation

Google Ads / Meta Blueprint certifications

Experience with server-side tracking, Triple Whale, or similar attribution tooling

Exposure to multi-language markets (e.g. Dutch-language campaigns)



Hours & setup



Remote, full-time

Mainly AU business hours 

Reports to Global head of digital marketing 

Works closely with the SEO, web/funnel, creative, content, and development tea
mbers



Compensation



Starting salary: USD 1,700 / month, with scope for increases based on performance and results





How to apply

Please send:



Proof of results (required) — case studies or account screenshots from real campaigns showing measurable outcomes (ROAS / CPA / CPL, before and after). Redact client-sensitive details, but the numbers must be real and you must be able to speak to them in detail.

A short write-up of your most successful paid campaign — the goal, what you did, and the result

Your portfolio showing Google and Meta work (LinkedIn a plus)

Which coverage hours you can commit to (UK/EU or ANZ)

Confirmation that the starting rate of USD 1,300 /month works for you





Applications without specific, verifiable results won't move forward. We hire on proven outcomes — not platforms you've "touched."



Hiring process

We run a structured process so it's a strong fit on both sides:



Application review — we screen for real, verifiable results. No proof, no progress.

Screening call (~30 min) — intro, background, and a check on your coverage hours.

Skills interview (~60 min) — you'll walk us through a past campaign in detail and talk through how you'd approach a sample brief or account audit.

Practical task (short, paid) — a real-world exercise, e.g. auditing a sample account or outlining a campaign structure, so we can see how you actually think and work.

Final interview — with [the founder / Head of Performance] to align on expectations and ways of working.

Offer & onboarding.

title: Facebook Ads Manager — Paid Media Strategist & Copywriter (Remote, Long-Term)
description:
ARE PE Partners is hiring a Paid Media Strategist and Copywriter to own our
 advertising. This is a senior role for someone who writes excellent direct-response copy and builds the strategy behind it. You'll develop the angles, write the hooks and ad copy, run the Meta campaigns, and own the results across a portfolio of U.S. home services businesses — HVAC, flooring, roofing, and plumbing.



We're looking for someone who is strong at both the writing and the strategy. If you're a direct-response copywriter who also wants to own campaign performance, this role is built for you. If you'd rather only manage budgets without writing — or only write without owning the numbers — it isn't the right fit.

Who we are



ARE PE Partners acquires and grows home services businesses across the U.S. and runs their marketing in-house. You'll focus on one industry and build deep expertise in what actually makes home services advertising convert. A hook or campaign that works for one brand can be rolled out across the others.

Here's what we live by as a team:



Trust — We're accountable and we deliver results, not stories or justifications. We make decisions that are a 4-way win (business, customers, team, owners), and we trust you to be a problem-solver, not just a task-doer.



Communication — We're responsive and great at following up. We have the hard conversations early, give and receive feedback well, then let it go. We ask for help when we need it and celebrate wins together.



Effort — We do what it takes. We don't hold ego. We are collaborators. The best idea wins. 



Trajectory — We're all rowing in the same direction at the same pace. We test assumptions quickly, take what works from good to great, and set the next goals together as we win.



Who we're looking for



A senior
 ads strategist who is, first and foremost, an excellent copywriter. You've spent years writing direct-response ad copy and running Meta campaigns, ideally for lead-generation businesses where the goal is booked jobs, not just clicks. You can write a sharp hook and then read the dashboard and know which one to scale. You're organized, proactive, and you follow through.



What you'll do



Copywriting and creative strategy (the core of this role)

- Write hooks, primary text, headlines, and ad scripts for home services offers

- Develop the angles and offers behind each campaign, grounded in audience insight and data

- Write clear creative briefs for designers and video producers and direct the creative concept

- Test continuously for hook rate, engagement, and conversion



 / Meta ads management

- Build, launch, and manage Meta campaigns — placements, bidding, audience targeting

- Run A/B tests on copy, hooks, creative, and audiences; scale winners and cut losers

- Manage budget and pacing across brands, adjusting from daily reporting

- A plus, not required: running Google and other platforms as a secondary channel



Analysis and reporting

- Track cost-per-lead, cost-per-booked-job, ROAS, CPA, CTR, and hook rate; turn the data into clear recommendations

- Maintain a record of copy and creative learnings to guide future tests

- Deliver weekly performance reports to leadership



Collaboration and light leadership

- Meet weekly with our operators on strategy, reporting, and creative

- Guide internal and outsourced creative teams with clear feedback

- Watch competitor ad libraries and home services trends to keep your angles fresh



What we offer

- $15/hr

- Long-term, stable, FULL-TIME remote work with a growing U.S. company

- BENEFITS — paid holidays

- A team that invests in your growth and sets goals with you

- Room to grow as the portfolio grows



Qualifications

- 4+ years writing direct-response copy and running
/Meta ad campaigns

- A portfolio of ad copy and hooks you've written (the first thing we'll review)

- Proven results with lead-generation or local-service campaigns; home services a plus

- Strong analytical skills — comfortable reading performance data and acting on it

- Fluent, professional English, written and spoken



Skills

- Direct-response copywriting: hooks, angles, offers, primary text, and scripts

-
/Meta ads strategy, testing, and optimization

- Translating performance data into copy and campaign decisions

- Organized, self-managing, and accountable for results



Technical requirements

- Stable internet (min. 25 Mbps) with a backup connection

- Quiet workspace for video calls

- Available to overlap with 9-5pm est

Your resume

A brief note on one campaign you're proud of: the result and your specific role in the copy and strategy

title: Social Media Manager / Growth Hacker for Indie Pop Artist: Long-Term Role (TikTok / IG Reels / YouTube Shorts)
description:
I'm building out a long-term content engine for an indie pop singer-songwriter on the US touring path toward 1000-cap rooms. She has a catalog that hasn't been campaigned with modern short-form tooling. I need someone who can grow it. 



Starting with a 4-week paid trial so we both confirm fit. Then ongoing.



WHAT YOU'LL DO EACH WEEK



- 5-7 TikTok clips + 5-7 IG Reels + 3-5 YT Shorts from raw footage we send you

- Multi-platform scheduling (Buffer or Metricool)

- Caption craft + hook discipline + thumbnail decisions

- DM triage and fan-feature curation (artist approves before any external send)

- Weekly geo-filtered analytics: USA primary; UK + Canada + Australia secondary

- Spot what's working, double down. Kill what's not. Propose the next bet.

- Daily report: what you did, what you're stuck on, what you need from us



When you're stuck, you tell me. Disappearing breaks the relationship.



WHAT WE NEED



One thing is non-negotiable: a real growth track record on a music, creator, or lifestyle account. Not corporate B2B. Not "I helped my agency client." An account you ran or co-ran where you can show me:



- The URL

- Follower / reach / engagement at the start vs at the end

- Timeframe

- What specifically YOU did that moved the numbers



If you can't show receipts, this role isn't for you.



You bring the editing stack (CapCut, Submagic, OpusClip, or your equivalent), the scheduling fluency, the analytics literacy, and native or near-native English. We onboard you to her voice corpus, her brand, and our content pipeline. We don't teach social media mechanics.



ENGAGEMENT & PAY



- 15-20 hrs/week, hourly via TimeProof + Payoneer

- $3-$10/hr depending on demonstrated growth track record

- Weekly pay for the first 8 weeks, then bi-weekly

- Bonuses are possible for exceptional work, not guaranteed, not scheduled. If you move the numbers past what we asked for, you'll be paid for it. If you don't, you won't. We pay for outcomes.

- Time off: you bill hours you log. If you'll be unavailable for >1 day, give me a heads-up so I don't think you've disappeared. No paid PTO. This is hourly work.



We provide: Buffer/Metricool seat, Canva Pro Brand Kit, Slack, Bitwarden vault, voice corpus access.

You bring: your editing stack, reliable hardware/internet, and the growth chops.



WHAT THE ARTIST KEEPS



She owns her songwriting, her Instagram Stories, all final outbound approval, brand partnership decisions, songwriting tie-ins, identity / brand evolution, and any communication with industry contacts. Locked in the contractor agreement, not negotiable.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Include the word PINEAPPLE in your subject line. No PINEAPPLE = I don't read it.

2. Receipts. ONE account you grew. URL + start vs end numbers + timeframe + what YOU specifically did. At interview, you'll live-screen-share into that account's analytics dashboard and walk me through the growth period. Don't submit an account you can't pull up live.

3. In 2-3 sentences: a music, creator, or lifestyle account whose growth you actively admire. What's specifically working? Name the post, the hook, or the choice. "Great engagement" gets rejected.

4. Tell me about a specific post YOU ran that flopped. What did you learn?

5. Current bandwidth? How many clients are you working? What roles?



ANTI-SCAM



I'll never ask for upfront payment. If you push to move off-platform (WhatsApp,
,
) before we've had a real interview, your application is dropped. Verify this account at onlinejobs.ph/jobseekers/employersearch using DTR Consortium 



I read every PINEAPPLE application with receipts personally.

title: Social media manager
description:

Linearity is a US luxury handbag brand, handcrafted in Ubrique, Spain and designed in Paris and the UK: mythology-inspired pieces shaped by nature. Our world is quiet and editorial, built on found natural light, muted warm tones, negative space, hands-and-craft imagery, and landscape (think Ladakh light meeting an Andalusian workshop). We're hiring one person to own our social presence end to end.

The role

Full ownership of Instagram (primary), TikTok, and Pinterest, from strategy to the published post. You take the raw materials we provide (professional photography, video footage, brand guidelines, templates) and turn them into a disciplined, beautiful, slow-luxury feed. You set the calendar, make the assets, write the words, publish, and tend the community.

This is a behind-the-brand role. We are NOT looking for an on-camera UGC creator or a personal-brand influencer. You won't be the face. You'll be the invisible hand that makes the brand look effortless.

What you'll own (end to end)



Strategy & calendar: monthly content plan across IG, TikTok, Pinterest; decide what posts, when, and with what narrative angle

Visual production: design carousels and feed tiles to our standard; edit supplied footage into slideshow-style Reels/TikToks (natural sound, atmospheric pacing) in CapCut/Premiere

Copy: captions and on-screen text in a restrained, reflective "notebook" voice that is spare, atmospheric, and never salesy

Publishing: schedule and post at optimal times, holding a strict grid composition

Pinterest: build and maintain curated boards

Community: respond to comments and DMs in the brand voice

Reporting: a simple monthly performance read covering what's working and what to adjust



You must have



2-4 years running brand social accounts end to end (not influencer/UGC collabs)

Strong English writing with a genuine feel for restraint and tone

Reliable, communicative, and respectful of deadlines

Experience with luxury, fashion, or craft/heritage brands

De La Salle College of Saint Benilde (Multimedia Arts / AB Photography): practical graphic design, video editing, and social-first visual execution







Not a fit if



Your work is bright, high-energy, salesy, or performer-forward

You're a UGC creator looking for paid collaborations

You need heavy direction for every single post



Logistics



Full-time, remote

Mostly async; some weekly overlap for live check-ins (our team spans the US, Paris, and the UK, so we'll align on a window)

$800-1,500/month USD, paid monthly, based on experience and portfolio

We begin with a paid one-month trial with clear deliverables before any ongoing commitment



How to apply

Read this carefully. Applications that skip these steps won't be considered.



Begin your message with the word UBRIQUE so I know you read the full post.

Write three sample captions in the voice described above, for a photo of a leather handbag resting on stone in soft natural light.

Link two brand accounts/grids you have personally run end to end (not collab or UGC reels), with one line on your role in each.

, paid media, content syndication, webinars, etc.) to drive top-of-funnel leads.

Budget & Resource Management

Process Optimization

title: Claude AI Implementation Specialist for E-commerce Store
description:
Hi,



I’m looking for an experienced Claude AI / AI Automation Implementation Specialist who can help implement Claude AI into the daily operations of my e-commerce business.



We run a Shopify fashion store and work with different processes such as product research, product listing, product page optimization, supplier communication, ad copy analysis, product testing, retesting and performance tracking.



I do not just need someone who “uses AI”. I need someone who can help me build practical workflows with Claude AI that my team can actually use every day.



Main goal



The main goal is to implement Claude AI into my business operations so we can work faster, more structured and more consistently.



This includes creating AI workflows, prompts, templates and systems that help the team with product research, product listing, product descriptions, product page feedback, ad copy analysis, supplier messages and internal SOPs.



Responsibilities



* Implement Claude AI into our e-commerce workflow

* Create clear AI workflows for product research, product listing and product testing

* Build prompt templates for the team

* Create AI-assisted systems for product descriptions, titles, hooks and product page improvements

* Help connect Claude AI with our Google Sheets workflow where possible

* Create a structured system for using AI in product testing and retesting

* Help analyze product data and suggest improvements using AI

* Create SOPs so the team knows exactly how to use Claude AI

* Train or guide team members on how to use the AI workflows correctly

* Improve communication workflows, such as supplier messages and internal feedback

* Think proactively about where AI can save time or improve quality in the business



Examples of workflows we want to build



* Product research assistant workflow

* Product listing assistant workflow

* Product title and description generator

* Product page quality-check system

* Ad copy and hook analysis workflow

* Winning product / losing product feedback system

* Retesting system for products with good ATC but no sales

* Supplier discount request template workflow

* SOP generator for team processes

* Google Sheets + AI workflow for tracking product status, pricing, testing results and next actions



Requirements



* Strong experience with Claude AI

* Experience creating practical AI workflows and prompt systems

* Experience with e-commerce, Shopify or dropshipping

* Strong Google Sheets experience

* Able to document workflows clearly

* Able to turn messy business processes into clear systems

* Good English communication

* Proactive mindset

* Able to explain systems simply to the team



Nice to have

* Experience with Google Sheets formulas, dashboards and automations

* Experience with Zapier, Make, Airtable or similar automation tools

* Experience with Meta Ads, ad creatives or product testing

* Experience with fashion e-commerce

* Experience creating SOPs for VAs or remote teams



What I’m looking for



I’m looking for someone who can look at my current workflow and help me decide where Claude AI can be implemented properly.



I want someone who can build a clear system, not just random prompts.



The ideal person should be able to create a full AI workflow for my team, including:



* What Claude should be used for

* Which prompts should be used

* How the output should be checked

* How the results should be added to Google Sheets

* How team members should use it

* How we can improve the workflow over time

Paid test task

This should include:



* Which processes can be improved with Claude AI

* Which workflows you would build first

* What prompts or templates are needed

* How it can be connected with our Google Sheets process

* What the expected benefit would be

title: Video & Social Media VA
description:
I'm looking for a highly capable, detail-oriented VA to support the content production side of Breast Wise, a breast cancer recovery and survivorship coaching brand based in New Zealand. This is a part-time role, 5 hours per week, with the potential to grow for the right person.

This is not a generalist VA role. I need someone who is fast, technically proficient, and takes pride in producing polished, on-brand content without needing hand-holding. Everything is pre-prepared for you. Your job is precise, efficient execution.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Social Media (approx. 1-2 hours per week)

Editing 5 short-form reels per week from raw footage using CapCut or within TikTok, adding provided captions, formatting for TikTok and Instagram, and scheduling via the platform scheduler. Magic clips from Riverside will also be provided weekly for upload and repurposing across TikTok and Instagram.



Podcast Production (approx. 1 hour per episode, fortnightly)

Accessing fully edited episodes in Riverside, adding pre-built intros and outros, generating show notes and episode titles using a custom ChatGPT prompt provided to you, scheduling the episode in Riverside, uploading to YouTube with show notes, thumbnail, and scheduling. This happens twice a month.



YouTube Thumbnail Design (per episode and per reel, fortnightly)

Working within the Breast Wise Canva brand kit and pre-built thumbnail template, you will update each YouTube thumbnail with the episode title generated from ChatGPT. Thumbnails must be visually consistent, mobile-optimised, emotionally compelling, and on-brand every single time. You understand that a thumbnail is a strategic growth asset for the channel, not an afterthought.



WHAT YOU MUST HAVE

Strong written and spoken English. Non-negotiable. You will be working with emotionally sensitive brand content serving women navigating breast cancer recovery. Tone, accuracy, and care matter enormously in this role.

Proven short-form video editing experience. You have edited reels for TikTok and Instagram for a real brand or client and you have the portfolio to prove it.



Canva proficiency. You can work confidently within a saved brand kit, update templates, and produce thumbnails that are consistent, clean, and on-brand without needing design direction every time.

Riverside.fm hands-on experience. You have worked inside Riverside, navigated recorded episodes, added intros and outros, used magic clips, and published or exported files. This is not a platform you are learning on the job.



YouTube strategy and thumbnail design experience. You understand YouTube as a growth platform. You know what click-through rate means and how thumbnail design directly affects it. You have designed YouTube thumbnails for a real channel and can show me the results.



CapCut editing proficiency. You are fast, clean, and accurate with CapCut for short-form video editing.

Self-directed and proactive communication. You read the brief, you follow it, and you ask questions before you go in the wrong direction, not after. You flag issues early and you meet deadlines without being chased.



Experience with a health, wellness, or purpose-led brand. You understand that this niche requires sensitivity, precision, and a level of care that generic content work does not demand.



TOOLS YOU WILL USE

CapCut, Canva, Riverside, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Google Drive, ChatGPT.



WHAT MAKES YOU THE RIGHT FIT

You have worked with a health, wellness, coaching, or purpose-led brand before. You understand that tone and presentation matter enormously in sensitive niches. You don't ask questions that are answered in the brief. You flag issues before they become problems. You treat someone else's brand with the same care you would your own.



HOURS AND RATE

5 hours per week, paid at USD $10 per hour. Payment monthly. This is a contractor role.



HOW TO APPLY

Please send a short video introduction of no more than 2 minutes telling me who you are, what social media and podcast VA work you have done before, and why this role interests you. Include links to any reels, social content, or podcast work you have produced. Applications without a video introduction and portfolio samples will not be considered.

CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: UNCOMPROMISING DATA ACCURACY

If you do not possess an extreme, borderline-obsessive eye for numbers and data integrity, please do not apply.



Job Title: Full-Time Bookings & Financial Admin Coordinator (Back-Office / US PST)

Type: Full-Time (40 hours per week)

Hours: US Pacific Business Hours (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)

Salary: $5.00 - $7.00 per hour (Paid weekly or monthly)

Reports to: Hospitality Director



Overview



-We are a premier, high-volume event and retreat venue in California's Sierra Foothills handling high-dollar contracts and bookings. We are hiring a methodical, highly organized, and self-managing Full-Time Virtual Assistant to support the financial and administrative side of our event operations.



-You will work entirely behind the scenes to keep contracts, payment logs, and system records accurate and current. While you will have no direct client interaction or financial decision-making authority, your work will directly fuel our on-site production team and must be executed with flawless precision. All output is reviewed internally by our Bookings Director.



What You Will Do



-Payment Tracking & Invoicing: Track deposit schedules and flag upcoming or missed payments against signed contracts. Maintain a rigorous payment tracking log and flag delinquent accounts to the Hospitality Director on a set cadence.

-CRM & Property System Management: Enter and update booking records across TripleSeat and ResNexus, including fees, charges, processing costs, applicable taxes, and payment statuses per contract templates.

-Production Scheduling: Review executed contracts to extract operational timelines and draft highly detailed "Run Of Show" documents used by our on-property event production team.

-Account Maintenance: Make consistent, uniform updates to client accounts, contracts, and events schedules as changes arise.

-Financial Reconciliation & Closeout: Assist with post-event financial reconciliations by compiling payment histories, documenting outstanding balances, and organizing damage assessment records. Manage strict contract closeout workflows across all internal systems.

The HR Admin Assistant supports day-to-day human resources operations with a strong focus on

employee records management, onboarding and offboarding, compliance, and employee services. This

role ensures accurate and audit-ready HR documentation, administer employment verification and leave

processes, and serves as a first point of contact for Tier-1 employee inquiries. The HR Assistant partners

closely with Talent Acquisition, Payroll, IT, and HR leadership to ensure seamless workforce transitions,

data integrity within HR systems, and timely payroll support. Through consistent process execution,

reporting, and continuous improvement efforts, this role contributes to efficient HR operations and a

positive employee experience.



ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the

essential functions.

Essential Functions:

Employee Records & Onboarding / Offboarding

and audit standards.

terminations, and updating access and distribution lists.

offboarding handoffs.

Verification, Documentation & Compliance

escalate risks prior to lapse.

and action.



Employee Services & Case Administration

coordination with Benefits and Payroll, including issuance of required notices.

maintaining claim records.

• Own HR inbox triage; resolve Tier-1 employee inquiries (policy basics, PTO routing, forms) and

escalate complex matters to HR Business Partners.

• Process live-on-site requests in accordance with policy and document approvals or denials.

Reporting, Systems & Continuous Improvement

• Maintain data integrity within the HRIS through routine audits and timely discrepancy resolution.

improve accuracy, efficiency, and turnaround times.

HR Administration & Payroll

duties as needed.

terminations, job changes, leaves of absence, and status updates between HRIS and Payroll.

and leave coding) and resolving discrepancies prior to payroll submission.

compliant I-9s, and clean HRIS and payroll data.

• Accountability - Takes ownership of onboarding/offboarding tasks, compliance tracking, case

follow-through, and timely completion of HR and payroll support activities.

• Communication - Effectively manages Tier-1 employee inquiries, coordinates with Payroll, TA,

IT, and HRBPs, and communicates deadlines and requirements clearly.

• Planning & Organization - Manages multiple HR workflows simultaneously, including

employee records, leave administration, audits, surveys, and payroll coordination.

• Safety & Compliance - Supports legal and regulatory requirements such as I-9 verification, EAD

tracking, LOA compliance, unemployment claims, and audit readiness.

Qualifications

Experience

• Minimum: High school diploma or equivalent; 2+ years of HR experience in HR operations or

generalist support.

• Preferred: BA/BS.

• Working knowledge of HRIS (e.g., Paylocity/Workday), document management, and

ticketing/inbox tools.

• Familiarity with I?9, EAD, FMLA/LOA basics, unemployment processes, and records retention.

title: Expert at Writing Online Dating Profiles (NO AI)
description:

We're looking for an exceptional writer who understands attraction, psychology, storytelling, and online dating at a deep level.



This is not traditional copywriting.



You won't be writing blog posts, advertisements, sales pages, or social media content.



Instead, you'll be crafting high-converting dating profiles for men on Tinder, Hinge, and Bumble.



Your job is to transform ordinary information about a client into a profile that immediately captures attention, creates intrigue, sparks attraction, and dramatically increases the likelihood that women swipe right, start conversations, and ultimately agree to dates.



What You'll Be Writing



For each client, you'll create:



Tinder bios

Bumble bios

Hinge prompts

Bumble prompts

Tinder profile prompts and profile text

Job title optimization

Occupation descriptions

Profile positioning and messaging

Alternative profile variations for testing



What Success Looks Like



The profiles you write should:



Attract the specific type of woman the client wants to meet

Differentiate the client from thousands of other men

Create curiosity and emotional engagement

Encourage women to swipe right

Encourage women to message first whenever possible

Make conversations start positively from the very first message

Create a natural pathway toward meeting in person

Feel authentic, natural, and completely aligned with the client's personality



The goal is not simply to write something funny or clever.



The goal is to strategically position the client so women are excited to match with him before a conversation even begins.



Who We're Looking For



You may be a great fit if:



You have extensive experience writing dating profiles

You deeply understand male-female attraction dynamics

You understand what women actually respond to on dating apps

You can write in multiple styles and personalities

You know how to create intrigue without sounding try-hard

You can make a profile feel confident, attractive, and authentic

You are an excellent interviewer and can quickly understand a client's personality

You have strong attention to detail

You consistently produce original work



Non-Negotiable Requirements

ABSOLUTELY NO AI-GENERATED WRITING



This role is for a genuine writer.



We are not looking for someone who generates content using ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Jasper, or any other AI writing tool.



Every profile must be written from scratch by a human.



We have extensive experience reviewing dating profiles and can immediately identify content that feels AI-generated.



If there is even the slightest indication that AI was used to write, heavily assist, or generate any part of the profile, your application will be rejected immediately and you will no longer be considered for future work.



We are specifically looking for writers who can produce original, natural, human-sounding content that reflects real personality, emotional intelligence, and nuanced social understanding.



To Apply



Please submit:



A brief introduction about yourself

Any experience writing dating profiles, personal branding content, or similar work



Follow these steps:

1. Open our Fulfillment Team Tracker: 
/spreadsheets/d/140BpHakCi0MkYrmsq2MWy9v70wPefTVQ__aWCR2Cxhg/edit?usp=sharing 



2. Pick one of our clients. Using the information the clients provided about themselves, write a Tinder/Bumble bio and 3 Hinge prompts. (If the client did not provide relevant info, just make up one.) The three Hinge prompts should start with...



a. "Together we could... "*insert here the romantic date idea. Be very specific about the details on the date (eg. location, what you're doing during the date) and use vivid imagery to make them visualise what it's like to go on a date with our male client. For example, "Together we could...watch the sunset over a glass of wine at the beach, and talk about our biggest dreams and fears."



b. My humble brag is/My greatest strength is.. *insert here what they are good at. Ideally, it would be something that could be related to the girl. For example, if a client works in sales, you can say "My humble brag is...I can convince you do whatever I want ;)". Another example: "My humble brag is...I'm essentially an expert in female psychology. "



c. The way to win me over is/Win me over by... *insert here a quality (that is not about her looks) that the client wants from his dream girl. The purpose of this prompt is to convey that he has standards, that he won't be satisfied with just any random girl, and to make the woman qualify or prove that she, in fact, possesses the qualities he desires. For example... "The way to win me over is...being able to cook me a nice ribeye with a cheeky kiss on the cheek."



The prompts should be fun, flirty, playful. It should focus on ONE key idea and elaborate on that one idea as opposed to listing different things. There should be no repetition of words or ideas in different parts of the profile. It should make the woman excited to get to know our male client and ideally make them want to go out with them on a date. Avoid generic lines, clichés, and recycled dating-app tropes.



We are looking for someone who can become a long-ter
mber of our team and help our clients achieve exceptional results on Tinder, Hinge, and Bumble.

title: CUSTOMER SUCCESS MANAGER (CSM)
description:
LEO LE EDUCATION



WE DON'T HIRE AVERAGE. WE HIRE ELITE.



NOW HIRING: CUSTOMER SUCCESS MANAGER (CSM)



Remote • Part-Time • Flexible Hours



“This is not a job for someone looking to coast. This is for a coach who is SERIOUS about impact.” — Leo Le Education



WHO WE ARE



Leo Le Education is Australia’s #1 career coaching program for migrants and international students. We exist for one reason: to help people from all over the world land their dream jobs in Australia — despite the lack of PR, despite the lack of local experience, and despite the odds.



In just two and a half years, we have helped 400+ migrants secure roles across some of Australia’s most competitive industries — from civil, mechanical, electrical, and structural engineering to construction management, project management, quantity surveying, biotechnology, accounting, and IT.



Our content is world-class, our clients are committed, and our standards are non-negotiable.



We don’t do average. We don’t do mediocre. And we definitely don’t hire coaches who wing it.



All coaching frameworks, content, and materials are fully built. We are not looking for someone to reinvent the wheel — we need someone who can DELIVER it with excellence, every single session.



THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF...



1. You are a credentialed, experienced coach who is hungry to do more



2. You thrive following a proven system and delivering consistent results



3. You show up prepared, professional, and on time — every time



4. You genuinely care about clients and their outcomes



5. You want flexible, meaningful contract work with a premium brand



WHAT YOU WILL DO



1. Deliver Leo Le Education’s coaching content, presentations, and teaching material to students — following the frameworks provided, bringing them to life with energy and clarity



2. Support clients through career transitions, job search strategy, confidence, and goal achievement



3. Run cold call sessions with students — 3 sessions for Diamond package students, 1 session for Gold package students



4. Get on the phones WITH students during cold call sessions — demonstrate live cold calling to employers, then coach students through their own calls in real time



5. Give detailed, actionable feedback to students on their cold calling technique — tone, script, objection handling, confidence, and follow-through



6. Submit concise session notes and student progress updates after every session



7. Attend a weekly debrief with Leo Le — 30 minutes, no fluff



8. Represent the Leo Le Education brand with the highest level of professionalism



9. Make outbound calls to leads who have expressed interest in Leo Le Education programs — build rapport, understand their goals, answer questions, and guide them toward the most suitable program.



WHAT WE REQUIRE



Non-Negotiables



1. ICF Certification (ACC, PCC, or MCC) is highly preferred — but if you have strong real-world coaching experience and a proven track record, we still want to hear from you



2. Minimum 2 years coaching experience — career coaching strongly preferred



3. Solid, real-world cold call experience — you have personally cold called employers or decision makers and know the process inside out. This is essential, not optional.



4. Confident and persuasive on the phone — students will be watching and learning from YOU



5. Strong presentation and facilitation skills — able to deliver pre-built content in an engaging, credible way



6. Professional-level spoken and written English



7. Stable internet and a clean, quiet video call setup



8. Must be able to work Australian Eastern time (AEST/AEDT) — all sessions run on Australian time



9. Minimum 5 hours per week for live coaching session delivery



10. Flexible availability required — cold call sessions are scheduled based on student bookings and will vary week to week. You will be notified in advance so you can prepare



11. Must be adaptable with your schedule — we need someone who can work around our students, not the other way around



Strong Advantage



1. Background in HR, Recruitment, Sales, or Career Services



2. Experience in outbound calling, headhunting, or recruitment — you know how to get through to employers



3. Experience delivering someone else’s coaching content or training framework



4. Prior experience coaching or mentoring others in job search, interview skills, or workplace readiness



COMPENSATION



AUD$14–A$20+ per hour (depending on experience, coaching ability, and performance).



Exceptional candidates with proven coaching, customer success, sales, or recruitment experience will be strongly considered at the higher end of the range.



Performance bonuses may be available for outstanding results and contribution to student success.



HOW TO APPLY



We move fast and we are selective. Here is what we need from you:



1. Your resume or professional coaching profile



2. Proof of current ICF credential



3. A 60-second to 2-minute video — tell us who you are, what drives you as a coach, and why Leo Le Education



4. Two professional references — coaches, clients, or employers



Shortlisted candidates will complete a live mock coaching session. We want to see you in action — not just read about you.



CONFIDENTIALITY & INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY



All successful candidates must sign a Contractor Agreement inclusive of a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) before commencing. By joining Leo Le Education, you agree to the following:



1. Ownership of Materials



All coaching content, frameworks, scripts, guides, tools, and resources provided to you are the exclusive intellectual property of Leo Le Education. You may not copy, share, reproduce, or use these materials outside of your contracted duties — ever.



2. Non-Solicitation



During and for 12 months after this contract, you may not directly approach, solicit, or engage any Leo Le Education client for independent coaching services.



3. Client Confidentiality



All client information is strictly confidential. No client details are to be disclosed to any third party, for any reason, at any time — including after the contract ends.



4. Return of Materials



Upon contract termination, all Leo Le Education materials must be immediately returned or permanently deleted from your devices.



5. Breach of Agreement



Any breach of these obligations will result in immediate contract termination and may result in legal action. We take our intellectual property seriously.



If you’re ready to deliver world-class coaching under a premium brand — apply now.



Leo Le Education • Empowering Careers. Transforming Lives.

title: Experienced Customer Support Manager for Nightcity Clothing (E-commerce Fashion) | Gorgias and Shopify Specialist
description:
We are looking for a full-time, experienced, **Customer Support Manager** to join **Nightcity Clothing** (
), a UK-registered ecommerce fashion brand selling modern occasionwear with an urban edge.



This role is focused on fully managing our customer support function across **Gorgias** and **Shopify**. You will be responsible for the daily support inbox, customer replies, Shopify order checks, Gorgias views, macros, rules, tags, AI Agent setup, escalation processes, public comment replies, product review replies, Trustpilot review replies, and overall customer support quality.



You will not be expected to figure everything out alone from day one. Our current Customer Support Manager will provide a structured handover, including our policies, customer tone, common ticket types, escalation rules, Gorgias setup, Shopify order checks, and examples of how we handle different customer situations.



This handover is designed to make the role easier to succeed in. You will be given context, examples, and guidance before taking full ownership.



Over time, the goal is for you to become the main owner of customer support, while our current Customer Support Manager moves more into another part of the company.



We are looking for someone who can be more than just a ticket responder. We want someone who can properly own customer support, improve our Gorgias setup, keep the inbox under control, make good decisions, reply well to public comments and reviews, and reduce the amount of daily guidance needed from the founder or other managers.



The ideal person is reliable, emotionally intelligent, detail-oriented, calm under pressure, and very strong at written customer communication.



Our customers range from Gen Z and older Gen Z shoppers to parents buying for their children’s events. You should be able to write in a friendly, natural, human way that feels helpful to younger customers, while still being clear, professional, and reassuring for parents.



Strong Gorgias and Shopify experience is essential for this role.



**Main Responsibilities**



* Own the daily customer support inbox inside Gorgias

* Reply to customer
s and messages in clear, friendly, professional English

* Help customers with order tracking, delivery updates, returns, exchanges, sizing questions, event deadlines, and general order support

* Use Shopify to investigate orders, customer details, fulfilment status, tracking, line items, payment status, shipping address, and order history before replying

* Create and manage useful Gorgias views for different ticket types, priorities, support queues, social comments, reviews, and escalations

* Set up, improve, and maintain Gorgias rules, macros, tags, views, and AI Agent processes

* Keep the support inbox organised, accurate, and under control every day

* Reply to Instagram comments, Meta ad comments, product page reviews, Trustpilot reviews, and customer feedback via Gorgias where needed

* Handle public replies carefully, especially when a comment or review could deter customers from the brand

* Turn negative public feedback into calm, reassuring, brand-protective replies without sounding defensive or robotic

* Work toward genuinely good outcomes for customers while also applying policies fairly and consistently

* Identify recurring customer issues and report them clearly to the team

* Help create and improve customer support SOPs and internal processes

* Escalate complex customer issues clearly when needed

* Take ownership of customer support quality, not just ticket completion



**Required Skills**



* Strong ecommerce customer support experience using **Gorgias and Shopify**

* Confident with Gorgias views, rules, macros, tags, AI Agent, inbox organisation, Shopify integration, and social tickets

* Confident using Shopify to investigate orders, tracking, fulfilment, payments, customer history, line items, and delivery issues

* Excellent written English with a friendly, natural, emotionally intelligent tone for Gen Z customers, older Gen Z customers, and parents

* Strong judgement when handling delayed orders, returns, exchanges, sizing questions, upset customers, public comments, negative reviews, and escalation situations

* Able to turn difficult customer situations into better outcomes while staying fair, consistent, and careful with company policies

* Highly organised, reliable, detail-oriented, and able to manage the support inbox every day without constant reminders

* Comfortable improving SOPs, reporting recurring issues, and suggesting better ways to run customer support



**Preferred Skills**



* Experience with fashion, clothing, apparel, or lifestyle ecommerce brands

* Experience replying to Instagram comments, Meta ad comments, product reviews, or Trustpilot reviews for a brand

* Experience training or guiding another support agent

* Experience managing a small customer support team

* Interest in trending fashion, outfits, styling, or ecommerce fashion brands



An interest in fashion would make this role more enjoyable and helpful, but it is not mandatory. We can train you on the brand and products. It just helps if you naturally understand what customers care about when buying clothing online.



**Schedule**



* 40 hours per week

* 8-hour shift per day

* Full-time role

* Exact working hours can be discussed, but there must be reliable daily coverage



**Paid Handover / Onboarding Period**



The first 90 days will be a paid handover and onboarding period.



During this time, our current Customer Support Manager will help transfer knowledge, explain our policies, show you how we handle common situations, and help you understand the brand’s customer tone.



This handover is designed to make the role easier to succeed in. You will not be thrown into the inbox with no context.



During this period, we will assess your customer support quality, written communication, reliability, Gorgias knowledge, Shopify knowledge, attention to detail, judgement, and ability to take ownership.



If the fit is strong, the goal is for you to become the main owner of customer support.



**Long-Term Opportunity**



This is not a basic ticket-answering role.



We are hiring for someone who can become the main person responsible for customer support at Nightcity Clothing.



As the company grows, we expect to hire more customer service people. If you perform well, understand our systems, show good judgement, and prove that you can lead the support function properly, you may have the opportunity to manage future customer service tea
mbers.



The long-term opportunity is to become the person we trust to run customer support day to day, maintain high reply quality, manage escalations, organise the support team, train future support agents, and make sure customers are being handled properly across
, Gorgias, Shopify, public comments, product reviews, Trustpilot reviews, and customer feedback.



Our current Customer Support Manager is expected to move more into another part of the company over time, especially merchandising and product-related work. Because of that, we are looking for someone who can take over customer support properly after a structured handover.



This depends on performance, reliability, judgement, writing quality, Gorgias ability, Shopify ability, emotional intelligence, and how well you understand the business.



**Perks**



* Competitive salary for the right person

* Long-term full-time role

* Clear ownership opportunity for someone who performs well

* Potential opportunity to manage future customer support tea
mbers

* Structured handover from the current Customer Support Manager

* Work directly with an established ecommerce fashion brand

* Opportunity to develop strong ecommerce customer support, Shopify, and Gorgias operations skills

* Flexible working hours where possible, as long as there is reliable daily coverage and good communication

* Performance review after the 90-day handover period

* Performance bonuses may be available for strong work, reliability, and long-term contribution



**About Nightcity Clothing**



Nightcity Clothing (
) is a UK-registered ecommerce fashion brand focused on modern occasionwear with an urban edge. We sell pieces designed for events, nights out, formal occasions, and customers who want something sharper than standard menswear - with a similar & growing women's range.



We care about clear communication, good customer experience, and building a support team that treats customers properly while also protecting the business with fair and consistent processes.



**Who This Role Is Best For**



This role is best for someone who genuinely cares about customers, can stay calm when dealing with frustrated people, and knows how to write replies that feel human, friendly, helpful, and reassuring.



You should be comfortable speaking to different types of customers. Some customers may be young people buying outfits for events, nights out, prom, graduation, or formal occasions. Some customers may be parents buying for their children.



Your writing should not sound robotic, overly corporate, or careless. It should feel warm, clear, and helpful.



This is also a role for someone who understands that public comments and reviews require a different kind of skill. A reply to an Instagram comment, Meta ad comment, product review, or Trustpilot review is not just for one customer. It is also seen by other potential customers, so it needs to be calm, reassuring, clear, and brand-protective without sounding defensive.



This is not a role for someone who only wants to complete tickets as quickly as possible. We want someone who understands that customer support is about solving the issue, making the customer feel heard, applying policies fairly, and keeping the business organised.



**To Apply for This Job**



Please follow these instructions carefully.



We are not looking for perfect textbook answers. We are looking for answers that show you have genuinely worked in ecommerce customer support, understand the situations we are describing, and can make sensible decisions when customers are frustrated, confused, or unhappy.



Specific, real, relatable experience is much more useful to us than generic answers. We want to see signs that you really know how Gorgias, Shopify, customer tickets, public comments, reviews, and difficult customer situations work in practice.



Because Gorgias experience is essential for this role, your Gorgias answers are very important. We are not looking for someone who has only replied to tickets in Gorgias. We are looking for someone who can help organise and improve the support system.



We understand that candidates may use AI tools to help polish their writing. That is okay. However, your experience, examples, and details must be real. Please do not submit answers that only sound good but do not reflect work you have actually done.



If we move forward, we may ask you to explain your answers in a live interview, including the Gorgias rules, views, macros, tags, AI Agent setup, Shopify order checks, or customer situations you mention.



You are welcome to share screenshots of your previous Gorgias setup, views, rules, macros, tags, AI Agent setup, or inbox structure if you want to. Please blur or hide all customer names,
s, order numbers, private company data, and sensitive information.



1. On OnlineJobs.ph, change the subject line to:

   **[Your name] - Nightcity Customer Support Manager**



2. Please attach your CV/resume, or include a link to it.



3. In up to 120 words, start with your strongest proof that you are a good fit for this role. This could be a specific ecommerce support role you handled, a Gorgias setup you improved, a difficult support situation you managed, or a team/support function you helped organise.



4. In up to 180 words, describe the most useful Gorgias rule, view, macro setup, tag structure, AI Agent improvement, or inbox organisation change you personally created or improved. Please include what problem you were trying to solve, what you changed inside Gorgias, what happened after, and one detail that would be hard to know unless you had actually used Gorgias.



5. In up to 120 words, describe one mistake, limitation, or frustrating issue you have experienced in Gorgias. For example, this could involve rules not working as expected, macros sounding robotic, views becoming messy, Shopify data not being enough, social tickets being difficult to manage, AI Agent needing human review, reporting not showing what you wanted, or tags becoming inconsistent. What happened, and how did you handle it?



6. In up to 100 words, describe your Shopify experience for customer support. What order details do you usually check before replying to a customer?



7. In up to 120 words, write a short example reply to this customer (you are welcome to make assumptions about the situation that is reasonable for our brand based on your research, and you can include hypothetical actions taken by yourself):

   “Where is my order? I needed this for an event and I’m getting really annoyed.” 



8. Please include your expected monthly salary in PHP and your usual working hours. Also confirm whether you can have some overlap with the United Kingdom timezone.



Do not write more than what we have asked for above. Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.



Thank you.

title: Video Editor (Short-Form / Social Content)
description:
We run Find My Place, a fast-growing student housing marketplace startup helping students find, buy, sell, and rate housing near college campuses. Our social media team films content on the ground here in the US — and we need a reliable, consistent video editor to turn that raw footage into polished, on-brand short-form videos.



Here's the workflow: our team films everything in America and drops the raw footage into shared folders. Your job is to edit it into the Find My Place style — clean, punchy, scroll-stopping short-form video (TikTok / Reels / Shorts). You'll work closely with our content lead to learn our style, and over time you'll own the editing so the team can focus on filming.



This is a high-trust, high-consistency role. The single most important thing we're looking for is someone reliable who shows up, hits turnaround, and delivers the same quality every single time.



What You'll Be Doing (Core Responsibilities)

- Edit raw footage into polished short-form vertical videos (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts)

- Cut for pace and retention — strong hooks, tight cuts, clean pacing that holds attention

- Add captions/subtitles, text overlays, transitions, music, and sound effects

- Apply and maintain our Find My Place brand style consistently across every video

- Pull the right clips from shared folders and organize your projects cleanly

- Iterate on feedback quickly as you learn our style (you'll be coached closely at the start)

- Hit agreed turnaround times consistently and communicate clearly on status



Requirements

- Proficiency in CapCut (our main editing tool) — and/or other industry-standard editors you're strong in (Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut). As long as you can match our style, we're flexible on tools.

- Strong eye for short-form pacing, hooks, and retention

- Clean, accurate captioning and text/motion work

- Strong written English communication

- Outstanding reliability and consistency — this is non-negotiable

- Reliable internet and a setup that can handle video editing

- Ability to take direction, apply feedback, and stay consistent over time

- High integrity and trustworthiness



Nice to Have (Not Required)

- Experience editing for social/short-form brands

- Motion graphics / animated text skills

- Basic color grading

- Familiarity with US/college culture or student-focused content

- Sound design / music selection instincts



Hours & Pay

- $5 USD/hour

- 2-week paid trial period so we can both confirm it's a good fit

- 8–10 hours/week to start, with the ability to add more hours as trust, value, and content production grow

- Long-term role with real growth potential for the right person



How to Apply

Please include:

- A short intro about your video editing experience

- Your portfolio or sample short-form videos you've edited (links are fine)

- The tools/software you're most proficient in

- Your resume

- Include the word "strawberry" in your response so we know you read the full post

 to give you context on our content and editing style.
